children: Evolution Metals provided initial revenue guidance of $5M–$8M for fiscal 2026 and $400M–$460M for fiscal 2027.
Announced FY2026 revenue guidance of $5 million to $8 million, reflecting current production base.
Projected FY2027 revenue of $400 million to $460 million, reflecting first full year from Pohang expansion.
Pohang capacity to rise to ~10,000 MT annually (including ~6,000 MT high-performance sintered NdFeB) with 13 ULVAC machines.
Expansion supported by planned power increase to ~750 MW, ~1.3M sq ft land acquisition and conditional ~$20.7M local grant.
Guidance depends on equipment commissioning, customer conversion, feedstock, working capital and other operational assumptions.
